subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add `registerControlUiEntryPoint` as a separate public plugin UI API, or consolidate the launch-token behavior into the existing Control UI descriptor/tab seam?
rationale: This chooses a durable third-party plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser trust contract that automation should not decide unilaterally.

options.title: Consolidate With Descriptor Tabs
options.body: Fold launch-token behavior into the existing plugin tab descriptor contract so plugin UI has one public seam and one sandbox model.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint` only after removing top-level execution, fixing fail-closed behavior, and documenting compatibility expectations.

options.title: Pause For RFC Alignment
options.body: Hold this PR behind the broader Control UI contribution-slot RFC if maintainers want one unified plugin UI vocabulary first.

recommendation.title: Consolidate With Descriptor Tabs
recommendation.body: Fold launch-token behavior into the existing plugin tab descriptor contract so plugin UI has one public seam and one sandbox model.

likelyOwner.reason: Their host-hook foundation and Control UI contribution-slot RFC are the closest existing API-shape ownership signals.
